digest.component_or_area: Rebar LLM Agent structured output and usage accounting
propositions: Successful Agent runs must report aggregate usage (requests and output_tokens) summed across all retry attempts in a single durable JSONL row, not per-attempt rows

Validation-failure exhaustion must re-raise the identical original Rebar StructuredOutputError object by walking the UnexpectedModelBehavior cause chain; output-size/truncation exhaustion with no Rebar object on the chain must construct a fresh UnretryableOutputError as the defined fallback
Terminal failure artifacts must preserve only the complete final provider response when artifact capture is enabled, without storing rejected intermediate attempt responses
Failure diagnostics must retain consumed requests, tool calls, and provider tokens without inventing usage values for calls that reported none
Existing pricing, historical rows, and usage schemas remain compatible with higher aggregate counters after successful retry, with no new request-budget competing fields like candidate_requests
